title: Re-running `cura setup` silently deletes the phone credentials
method: end-to-end drive of setup -> add-phone -> setup with a throwaway HOME
triggers: cura setup (a second time, after cura add-phone)
observed_at_discovery: After add-phone, ~/.cura/margaret.json contained the twilio block. Running `cura setup` again asked nothing, printed 'All set. Cura is ready.' in under a second, and the reread config had no twilio key at all. wizard.run() rebuilds the config dict from the progress file and overwrites the file; the twilio block written by add-phone is never read. cura/setup/gui.py finish() has the identical shape. Nothing warns, and phone_enabled stays true in the progress file, so nothing later suggests re-running add-phone.
